newsitem.title: FINLAND: AKTIA SAYS PERSONNEL TO BE OFFERED SHARES.
newsitem.headline: AKTIA SAYS PERSONNEL TO BE OFFERED SHARES.

text.p: Finnish Aktia Bank said in a statement on Friday Forvaltnings Ab Tarnan will offer 142,390 Aktia shares to Aktia's personnel for 14.00 markka per share.
"Forvaltnings Ab Tarnan ... has decided to offer the bank's personnel the shares which the company subscribed in Aktia's share issue in August 1996," Aktia said.
The nominal value of Aktia shares is 12.00 markka each.
Tarnan is owned by five Helsinki-based foundations that promote savings, Aktia said.
Aktia employees will have the opportunity to buy at least 300 and no more than 10,000 shares each in numbers divisible by 10, with the buyer paying the stamp duty, it said.
Sales of shares to employees will begin before the new year, the bank said. It did not say when it planned to apply for a bourse lisating.
